The South West Bounce

The South West Bounce deliver floor-filling pop, soul & RnB party hits with a full brass section & live DJ option. Feel-good fun from first note to final encore

About The South West Bounce

The South West Bounce is a feel-good party band blending the best of pop , soul , and RnB with a vibrant live brass section and optional manned DJ playlist . Fronted by soul-stirring vocalist Rebecca , their lineups range from a slick 4-piece to a full-blown 8-piece , including guitar , bass , drums , keys , trumpet , sax , and trombone . The band’s members are in-demand pros , trained at elite schools like BIMM , Royal Birmingham Conservatoire , and Hochschule für Musik . Their credits include Wembley Arena , IOW Festival , Royal Albert Hall , and even Cirque Du Soleil . Expect high energy, tailored setlists , and a polished, professional vibe every time. From Dusty Springfield to Dua Lipa , hip-hop to retro pop , they’ll get the dancefloor moving—and keep it there. Book The South West Bounce and get the full party package, hassle-free.
